The superstars showed up today.

Messi, Mbappé & Haaland each scored twice.

If any of these dream matchups happen, World Cup ratings will explode:

USA vs Iran (10–15%)
France vs Argentina III (20–30%)
Messi vs Ronaldo (10–20%)

FIFA’s dream scenario?

Messi vs Ronaldo.

But France vs Argentina would be an epic trilogy after their clashes in 2018 and the legendary 2022 Final.

Either way, the next few weeks should be spectacular.
